I replied to Ilse in their DM. I confirmed that the new cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork is 7 July and that it will stay in that DM. My first try, a direct message addressed to "Ilse Varga", failed because no member matched that name, so I posted to the DM channel instead.

I didn't save the date to the shared GBrain memory, because anything stored there could reach other members and Ilse asked for it to stay private. It's kept only in that DM. Nothing else needed doing, since they said no action was needed.
